Class ProceduralPlanetRasterSynthesizer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.generation.ProceduralPlanetRasterSynthesizer
public final class ProceduralPlanetRasterSynthesizer extends Object
Procedural Planet Raster Synthesizer. Synthesizes equirectangular raster suites (elevation, biomes, temperature, rainfall, seasonality) using deterministic spherical Simplex noise.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • synthesizeProceduralPlanetRasters

      public static ProceduralPlanetRasterSynthesizer.ProceduralRasterSuite synthesizeProceduralPlanetRasters(ProceduralGenerator generator, PlanetPreset preset, int width, int height)
      Synthesizes a complete set of procedural equirectangular rasters ($2048 \times 1024$) using deterministic spherical Simplex noise so procedural planets pass through the exact same spherical H3 aggregation pipeline as empirical maps.
      Parameters:
      generator - parent procedural generator
      preset - planet generation preset
      width - target raster width
      height - target raster height
      Returns:
      immutable ProceduralPlanetRasterSynthesizer.ProceduralRasterSuite
